title: PSPi 6 – Raspberry Pi in a PSP
summary: A hardware modding project that embeds a Raspberry Pi computer inside a modified PSP (PlayStation Portable) case, creating a portable handheld gaming device capable of running retro game emulators or Raspberry Pi OS.
problem_solved: Provides an affordable, customizable handheld gaming device by repurposing the iconic PSP form factor with modern single-board computing hardware.
why_valuable: It offers makers and retro gaming enthusiasts a DIY path to a unique handheld device that combines nostalgic PSP aesthetics with the flexibility of Raspberry Pi software ecosystem.
